          `LHS`.`gender` AS `gender`,
          `LHS`.`student_capacity` AS `student_capacity`,
          `LHS`.`n_distinct` AS `n_distinct`
   FROM
     (SELECT `LHS`.`stuid` AS `stuid`,
             `LHS`.`lname` AS `lname`,
             `LHS`.`fname` AS `fname`,
             `LHS`.`age` AS `age`,
             `LHS`.`sex` AS `sex`,
             `LHS`.`major` AS `major`,
             `LHS`.`advisor` AS `advisor`,
             `LHS`.`city_code` AS `city_code`,
             `LHS`.`dormid` AS `dormid`,
             `LHS`.`room_number` AS `room_number`,
             `RHS`.`gender` AS `gender`,
             `RHS`.`student_capacity` AS `student_capacity`,
             `RHS`.`n_distinct` AS `n_distinct`
      FROM
        (SELECT `LHS`.`stuid` AS `stuid`,
                `LHS`.`lname` AS `lname`,
                `LHS`.`fname` AS `fname`,
                `LHS`.`age` AS `age`,
                `LHS`.`sex` AS `sex`,
                `LHS`.`major` AS `major`,
                `LHS`.`advisor` AS `advisor`,
                `LHS`.`city_code` AS `city_code`,
                `RHS`.`dormid` AS `dormid`,
                `RHS`.`room_number` AS `room_number`
         FROM `student` AS `LHS`
         INNER JOIN `lives_in` AS `RHS` ON (`LHS`.`stuid` = `RHS`.`stuid`)) AS `LHS`
      CROSS JOIN
        (SELECT `gender`,
                `student_capacity`,
                COUNT(DISTINCT `gender`) AS `n_distinct`
         FROM `dorm`
         GROUP BY `gender`,
                  `student_capacity`) AS `RHS`) AS `LHS`
   INNER JOIN
     (SELECT *
      FROM
        (SELECT `gender`,
                `student_capacity`,
                COUNT(DISTINCT `gender`) AS `n_distinct`
         FROM `dorm`
         GROUP BY `gender`,
                  `student_capacity`)
      WHERE (`gender` != 'M')) AS RHS ON (LHS.gender = RHS.gender
                                          AND LHS.student_capacity = RHS.student_capacity
                                          AND LHS.n_distinct = RHS.n_distinct))
ORDER BY count___

FROM
  (SELECT LHS.player_id AS player_id,
          LHS.sponsor_name AS sponsor_name,
          LHS.player_name AS player_name,
          LHS.gender AS gender,
          LHS.residence AS residence,
          LHS.occupation AS occupation,
          LHS.votes AS votes,
          LHS.rank AS rank,
          RHS.player_id AS player_id_other,
          RHS.sponsor_name AS sponsor_name_other,
          RHS.player_name AS player_name_other,
          RHS.gender AS gender_other,
          RHS.residence AS residence_other,
          RHS.occupation AS occupation_other,
          RHS.votes AS votes_other,
          RHS.rank AS rank_other,
          RHS.n AS n
   FROM player AS LHS
   INNER JOIN
     (SELECT player_id,
             sponsor_name,
             player_name,
             gender,
             residence,
             occupation,
             votes,
             rank,
             n,
             MAX(n) OVER () AS maxn
      FROM
        (SELECT player_id,
                sponsor_name,
                player_name,
                gender,
                residence,
                occupation,
                votes,
                rank,
                COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
         FROM player)) AS RHS ON (LHS.player_id = RHS.maxn))
ORDER BY occupation

SELECT minn AS engineer_id,
       first_name,
       last_name
FROM
  (SELECT first_name,
          last_name,
          MIN(n) AS minn
   FROM
     (SELECT engineer_id,
             company_id,
             first_name,
             last_name,
             other_details,
             n,
             company_id AS engineer_visit_id
      FROM
        (SELECT engineer_id,
                company_id,
                first_name,
                last_name,
                other_details,
                engineer_id AS n
         FROM
           (SELECT LHS.engineer_id AS engineer_id,
                   LHS.company_id AS company_id,
                   LHS.first_name AS first_name,
                   LHS.last_name AS last_name,
                   LHS.other_details AS other_details
            FROM maintenance_engineers AS LHS
            INNER JOIN
              (SELECT engineer_visit_id,
                      COUNT(*) AS n
               FROM engineer_visits
               GROUP BY engineer_visit_id) AS RHS ON (LHS.engineer_id = RHS.n
                                                      AND LHS.company_id = RHS.engineer_visit_id))))
   GROUP BY first_name,
            last_name)
ORDER BY engineer_id
